## Summary

Describe the user or engineering problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Source of Truth

State the authoritative file or package for this change. For API changes, name the OpenAPI specification path. For generated code, confirm regeneration.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] Focused manual verification completed, if applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated, if behavior or operations changed

## Risk and Rollback

Describe any security, data, compatibility, or deployment risk. State how the change can be reverted safely.

## Screenshots or Evidence

Attach evidence for visual or user-facing changes. Do not attach secrets, production data, or personally identifying information.
